## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Optional @opentui-ui/dialog patch for opentui 0.4.x (deps, ~6h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #12516 patches @opentui-ui/dialog 0.1.2 (abandoned upstream,
  built for opentui core ^0.1.69 with remove(id: string) signature) to work with
  opentui 0.4.x (renamed remove(child: Renderable) and throws on string). The
  patch (bun patch format) passes the renderable object on all three bindings
  (react, solid, core container). Without it, dialog close (model picker, help,
  command palette) unmounts React portal content but leaves the grey box on
  screen. The PR adds tui-test asserting #262626 background is fully gone after
  help dialog close.
- **Why**: Alexi uses Ink 7.1.1 (React 19) for TUI (`src/cli/tui/`,
  `src/cli/interactive.ts`), not opentui. No @opentui-ui/dialog dependency
  exists in `package.json`. SKIP (not applicable to Ink architecture).
- **Source**: cline/cline PR #12516 "fix(cli): patch @opentui-ui/dialog for
  opentui 0.4.x remove() contract" (merged 2026-07-25T03:27Z, commit `5c8f2a1`).
  Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12516.
- **Category**: deps. **Size**: moderate (~6h if applicable: vendor patch file,
  add patch script, test dialog lifecycle, update docs). **Status**: SKIP (Alexi
  uses Ink, not opentui).

#### 2. Docs-sync workflow with watermark self-healing (ci, ~5h, SKIP)

- **What**: Kilocode #12512 adds daily docs-sync bot workflow keeping
  packages/kilo-docs in sync with merged PRs from Kilo-Org/cloud and
  Kilo-Org/kilocode. Components: watermark.mjs (processing window from bot's own
  PR body marker, 72h fallback, 14d cap), collect.mjs (queries merged PRs,
  pre-filters bots/chores/docs-only), triage.mjs (classifies PRs in chunks of 25
  with kilo run; failed chunks degrade to unclassified), edit.mjs (updates docs
  in batches of 5 PRs; failures surface as skipped entries), verify (builds +
  tests kilo-docs; one LLM fix pass on failure; still-red becomes draft PR),
  upsert-pr.mjs (maintains one rolling auto-docs PR, appends while open, fresh
  branch after merge, 15-file draft cap, machine-readable processed-through
  watermark). Self-healing: no external state (watermark in PR body), merge
  conflict keeps old branch + continues on fresh dated branch.
- **Why**: Alexi has no docs subpackage requiring automated sync. The repo is
  single-package npm (no packages/ monorepo, no kilo-docs equivalent). SKIP (no
  target for sync workflow).
- **Source**: Kilo-Org/kilocode PR #12512 "feat: daily docs-sync bot keeping
  kilo-docs in sync with merged PRs" (merged 2026-07-25T08:12Z, commit
  `7a9e2f3`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12512.
- **Category**: ci. **Size**: moderate (~5h if applicable: port watermark /
  collect / triage / edit scripts, add verify step, upsert-pr logic, test
  self-healing). **Status**: SKIP (Alexi is single-package, no docs subpackage).
